cases.title: Sandbox vendor configuration preflight
cases.steps:
1: Reset DB Playwright
2: Call /__test/sandbox/status
3: Verify PayOS/FPT/public tunnel readiness when sandbox flags are enabled
cases.expected: Sandbox reports ready or lists exact missing configuration keys.

cases.title: PayOS sandbox payment link creation
cases.steps:
1: Seed payos-vendor-checkout scenario
2: Create PayOS sandbox checkout
3: Verify order code and checkout URL are persisted
cases.expected: PayOS sandbox checkout URL and order code are returned for a Playwright hold.

cases.title: PayOS full vendor webhook converts paid hold
cases.steps:
1: Open PayOS sandbox checkout
2: Complete sandbox payment outside the app
3: Poll /__test/payments/wait-paid
cases.expected: Real PayOS webhook marks transaction paid and creates/updates booking records.

cases.title: FPT eKYC sandbox OCR and face compare
cases.steps:
1: Login customer
2: Upload vendor sandbox CCCD/GPLX/selfie fixtures
3: Submit eKYC
cases.expected: FPT sandbox returns OCR/face result and app handles response without provider mock.

cases.title: OwnerCars map address and coordinates required
cases.steps:
1: Login owner
2: Open OwnerCars/Create
3: Submit without map coordinates
cases.expected: Server rejects submission and reports required address/map location.

cases.title: OwnerCars image upload minimum validation
cases.steps:
1: Submit owner car with fewer than 4 images
2: Inspect validation response
cases.expected: Upload is blocked with minimum 4 image validation.

cases.title: OwnerCars image preview accepts 4 sandbox files
cases.steps:
1: Select four PNG files
2: Verify preview cards and counter
3: Remove one image
cases.expected: Preview grid updates and counter reflects selected files.

cases.title: Admin car amenities show existing selections
cases.steps:
1: Seed admin amenity scenario
2: Login admin
3: Open Admin Car Edit
cases.expected: Amenity checklist contains and checks seeded amenity.

cases.title: Admin car amenities add a new feature
cases.steps:
1: Add new amenity name on admin car form
2: Save
3: Reopen details
cases.expected: New amenity is created once and mapped to car.

cases.title: Admin car amenities edit sync and details display
cases.steps:
1: Toggle amenity mapping
2: Save edit
3: Open details
cases.expected: Details displays CarAmenityMappings and falls back to legacy Features only when needed.

cases.title: Delivery quote missing coordinates is blocked
cases.steps:
1: Select owner delivery on car details
2: Try checkout with address but no lat/lng
cases.expected: Client/server keep user on delivery step and show coordinate required message.

cases.title: Delivery quote out of range is blocked
cases.steps:
1: Call delivery quote with distant coordinates
2: Try checkout
cases.expected: Out-of-range destination is rejected using coordinate-based scope.

cases.title: Delivery checkout fee is server recomputed
cases.steps:
1: Request checkout with hidden client fee tampered
2: Inspect rendered checkout fee
cases.expected: Server recomputes distance/ETA/fee and ignores tampered hidden values.

cases.title: Customer tracking map shows fallback or live state honestly
cases.steps:
1: Login customer
2: Open Tracking/Booking
3: Inspect status text and map markers
cases.expected: Map labels live/stale/fallback and never pretends fallback is realtime.

cases.title: Mobile tracker posts GPS and snapshot updates
cases.steps:
1: Login staff
2: POST MobileUpdate with real coordinates
3: Customer polls Snapshot
cases.expected: Snapshot returns latest GPS, ETA/distance and route coordinates.

cases.title: Tracking stale GPS warning
cases.steps:
1: Seed stale tracking scenario
2: Open customer tracking page
3: Inspect stale state
cases.expected: UI/API reports stale tracking instead of live.

cases.title: Handover capture stores geolocation
cases.steps:
1: Stub browser geolocation
2: Open Handover Capture
3: Submit capture data
cases.expected: Handover record stores GeoLatitude/GeoLongitude and page remains healthy.

cases.title: Traceability report includes Playwright addendum
cases.steps:
1: Load testcase matrix and addendum
2: Generate traceability report
cases.expected: Report includes TC001-TC543 and MD26 cases.
